One log group with retention_in_days = 365, exactly at the baseline (matrix: at least 365).
RDS backup_retention_period = 1, exactly at the SCOF baseline (matrix: at least 1); encrypted with a rotating CMK; not public.
IAM policy: a scoped Allow plus a Deny statement on Action "*" and Resource "*". Matrix: no statement may Allow Action * on Resource *; a Deny is not an Allow.
IAM policy: Allow Action ["s3:*"] on Resource ["*"]. Matrix check is Action "*" on Resource "*"; a service-level wildcard is not that.
IAM policy: one Allow statement with scalar string Action "*" and scalar string Resource "*" (not lists).
